prompt: Production game scenery asset for SpeakUp educational website, ONE isolated landscape prop only: [subject]. Strictly FLAT 2D vector-like storybook illustration matching an elegant website roadmap mockup: simple geometric silhouettes, clean smooth edges, restrained fine outlines only where necessary, matte solid fills, no gradients, no glossy lighting, no rendered 3D, no realistic textures, no perspective-heavy isometric scene. Consistent palette sage #94B889, warm wood #C59B68, pale cream #FFF7E5, orange #F6A14B, teal #A9D5D9. Delicate organic detail, readable at 150-200px. Compact composition centered with generous safe margin. Truly transparent background outside the prop; minimal small flat grounding grass or water patch allowed, no rectangular background, no text, no labels, no mascot, no lesson nodes, no UI, no ground shadow blur. This will be placed BESIDE a learning path, not across it. Asset should feel like a friendly sophisticated 2D adventure garden world.
